body:
Name: iiSTiiKY
Reason for infraction: Disrespect to other players
Why my infractions should be removed: Last week I was hacked from January 1st-5th on my MC account, and I believe it was a key logger through my email, but I'm not sure. I received an email about MC Realms and I think that may have been the problem (It was a fake email). I don't have much proof though so I don't really know, it's up to you to remove the infractions. (Players told me that I wasn't acting as I normally did, so that's also proof I was hacked.) That's about it for now, but if you could remove my infractions from Jan. 1st and 2nd that would be nice to have them off my punishment record.
